name: Not Of This World
overview: Scripture reveals that believers are distinctly set apart from the world, just as Jesus Himself declared that He is not of this world (John 8:23). This separation results in opposition and hatred from the world, which rejected Christ and consequently hates His followers as well (John 15:18-19; John 17:14). Jesus emphasizes that His kingdom is not of this world, underscoring the spiritual nature of His reign and the believer's allegiance to a heavenly kingdom rather than earthly systems (John 18:36). Thus, Christians are called to live as citizens of a kingdom that transcends worldly values and conflicts.
